UC-388.hi: '{text}' के पीछे का वेब पता बदल गया है।
UC-388.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-388.note: over the blackline sheet, one line per link whose web address changed while its text stayed ({text} is the link's text); stetdoc 0.9.3's compare marks no change for it (WordBlackline changed_links)

UC-389.en: A comment's text changed. Open both versions in Word to see it.
UC-389.hi: एक टिप्पणी का पाठ बदल गया है। इसे देखने के लिए दोनों संस्करण Word में खोलें।
UC-389.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-389.note: over the blackline sheet when a comment's text differs between the versions; the sheet doesn't show comments (BlacklineNotice comment_changed)

UC-390.en: Text in a text box changed. Open both versions in Word to see it.
UC-390.hi: एक टेक्स्ट बॉक्स का पाठ बदल गया है। इसे देखने के लिए दोनों संस्करण Word में खोलें।
UC-390.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-390.note: over the blackline sheet when a text box's text differs between the versions; the sheet shows the new box text but not the old (BlacklineNotice text_box_changed)

UC-391.en: The formatting of some tables, rows or cells changed.
UC-391.hi: कुछ तालिकाओं, पंक्तियों या सेल की फ़ॉर्मैटिंग बदल गई है।
UC-391.note: over the blackline sheet when a table's, a row's or a cell's formatting changed and the host names no table (only stetdoc's check listed a tracked cell format change; changed_tables empty). Reworded by blackline PR 2 (was 'The formatting of some table cells changed.'), since the notice now covers a table's own and a row's formatting too; when tables are named, UC-452 or UC-453 stands instead (BlacklineNotice cell_format_changed)
